presets.label: AO3-style
presets.description: The five ratings most fanfiction archives use.

values.name: General Audiences
values.description: Suitable for any reader. Nothing a child should not see.

values.name: Teen And Up Audiences
values.description: Suitable for readers of about thirteen and older: some violence, strong language or romance without detail.

values.name: Mature
values.description: For adult readers: stronger violence, sexual themes or other mature material, not shown in full detail.

values.name: Explicit
values.description: For adult readers: graphic sexual or violent material.

values.name: Not Rated
values.description: The author has not chosen a rating.

presets.label: FanFiction.net-style
presets.description: The letter ratings from K to MA.

values.name: K
values.description: Suitable for every age.

values.name: K+
values.description: Suitable for readers of about nine and older: mild peril or gentle themes.

values.name: T
values.description: Suitable for teenagers and older: moderate violence, language or romance.

values.name: M
values.description: For older teenagers and adults: strong violence, language or suggestive material.

values.name: MA
values.description: For adults only: explicit material.

values.name: Not Rated
values.description: The author has not chosen a rating.

presets.label: Movie-style
presets.description: The familiar film ratings, described for stories.

values.name: G
values.description: Suitable for every reader.

values.name: PG
values.description: Mostly suitable for all, though some themes may need a parent's judgement for young readers.

values.name: PG-13
values.description: Some material may be unsuitable for readers under thirteen: action violence, strong language or romance.

values.name: R
values.description: Restricted: strong violence, language or sexual material, for older teenagers and adults.

values.name: NC-17
values.description: For adults only: explicit sexual or violent material.

values.name: Not Rated
values.description: The author has not chosen a rating.

presets.label: Minimal (original fiction)
presets.description: Three plain choices for an archive of original stories.

values.name: Everyone
values.description: Suitable for readers of any age.

values.name: Teen
values.description: May include themes or scenes that suit older children and teenagers.

values.name: Mature
values.description: For adult readers, with strong or explicit themes.
